答案:
1 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. R ─ 蕨類植物
C. R ─ Fern
📌 詳細解釋
P是有花植物，Q是黴，而S是無花、具有毬果的植物。
P is a flowering plant, Q is a mould, and S is a non-flowering coniferous plant.
因此，只有R被正確配對為蕨類植物。
Therefore, only R is correctly matched as a fern.
📌 考試提醒
考生必須熟記各大植物類群的典型特徵及其生殖方法。
Candidates must memorize the typical features and reproductive methods of major plant groups.
常見錯誤：誤以為具有葉片狀構造的物種必然是有花植物。
Common trap：Mistaking all species with leaf-like structures as flowering plants.

2 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. Q有葉綠素。
B. Q has chlorophyll.
📌 詳細解釋
Q是麵包黴，屬於真菌界，並不含有葉綠素，不能進行光合作用。
Q is bread mould, which does not contain chlorophyll and cannot carry out photosynthesis.
A、C和D的描述皆符合該生物的真實特徵，故不選。
The descriptions in A, C, and D correctly match their true characteristics, thus are not selected.
📌 考試提醒
真菌屬於異養生物，絕不含有葉綠素。
Fungi are heterotrophs that never contain chlorophyll.
常見錯誤：將真菌的綠色孢子誤認為是葉綠素。
Common trap：Mistaking the green colour of fungal spores for the presence of chlorophyll.

3 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. 牠們有脊柱。
A. They have a vertebral column.
📌 詳細解釋
蛙、蜥蜴和鳥同屬於脊椎動物，皆具有脊柱。
Frogs, lizards, and birds are vertebrates and possess a backbone.
蛙和蜥蜴是冷血動物，且蛙沒有鱗片或爪，因此B、C及D均為錯誤。
Frogs and lizards are cold-blooded, and frogs lack scales or claws, making options B, C, and D incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
溫血動物僅包含鳥類與哺乳類。
Warm-blooded animals only include birds and mammals.
常見錯誤：誤以為所有陸生脊椎動物皆擁有鱗片或恆定體溫。
Common trap：Assuming all terrestrial vertebrates possess scales or a constant body temperature.

4 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. (3) → (2) → (1)
D. (3) → (2) → (1)
📌 詳細解釋
在細胞分裂前，染色體必須先進行複製（3）。
Before cell division, chromosomes must duplicate first (3).
然後它們會排列在紡錘體的赤道上（2），最後分離（1）。
They then arrange themselves at the equator of the spindle (2) and separate consequently (1).
📌 考試提醒
有絲分裂的基礎順序為：DNA複製、赤道板排列、分離移向兩極。
The basic sequence for mitosis is: DNA replication, equatorial alignment, and separation to opposite poles.
常見錯誤：混淆染色體排列與分離的先後次序。
Common trap：Confusing the order of chromosome alignment and separation.

5 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 透析管只容許還原糖通過。
C. The dialysis tubing only allows reducing sugars to pass through.
📌 詳細解釋
本立德溶液測試只能查出有還原糖存在，但不能精確辨認是否為葡萄糖，故不能推論出A。
Benedict's solution only detects the presence of reducing sugars but cannot distinguish if it is exactly glucose, hence A cannot be deduced.
單憑此溶液無法確認透析管外是否存在澱粉，亦無法測量水勢，故B和D皆錯誤。
This solution alone cannot determine whether starch exists outside the tubing, nor can it measure water potential, so B and D are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
本立德試劑專用於檢測還原糖，不能檢驗澱粉。
Benedict's reagent is specifically used to detect reducing sugars and cannot test for starch.
常見錯誤：誤將出現紅色沉澱直接等同於產生了葡萄糖。
Common trap：Directly equating a red precipitate with glucose production.

6 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. xoq
D. xoq
📌 詳細解釋
光學顯微鏡下所形成的影像，會在上下及左右兩個方向同時顛倒。
The image formed under a microscope is inverted upside down and laterally.
字母顛倒並反轉後會形成「xoq」。
The letters form 'xoq' after being inverted and laterally reversed.
📌 考試提醒
顯微鏡下的影像永遠是上下左右完全倒置的。
Images under a microscope are always completely inverted both vertically and laterally.
常見錯誤：只記得上下顛倒或左右顛倒其中一項。
Common trap：Only remembering either vertical or lateral inversion but not both.

7 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. 0時至0.5時。
A. Hour 0 to hour 0.5.
📌 詳細解釋
滲透作用的速率可以從質量變化曲線圖的斜率來量度。
The rate of osmosis can be measured by the slope of the graph.
由0時至0.5時的這段時間內，曲線的斜率最大，顯示滲透速率最高。
Between hour 0 and hour 0.5, the slope is greatest, indicating the highest rate of osmosis.
📌 考試提醒
質量-時間關係圖的斜率代表反應或物理變化的速率。
The slope of a mass-time graph represents the rate of reaction or physical change.
常見錯誤：誤將質量最高的時刻當作速率最高的時刻。
Common trap：Mistaking the time with the highest mass as the time with the highest rate.

8 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. 細胞是硬脹的。
A. The cells are turgid.
📌 詳細解釋
馬鈴薯細胞為植物細胞，外層具備堅硬的細胞壁。
Potato cells are plant cells which have rigid cell walls.
當水份經滲透作用進入細胞時，細胞最終會變硬脹，但不會脹破。
When water enters the cells by osmosis, the cells will become turgid eventually but will not burst.
📌 考試提醒
植物細胞在純水中會達到硬脹狀態而不會破裂。
Plant cells will reach a turgid state in pure water without bursting.
常見錯誤：以為曲線呈水平代表水分子完全停止進出細胞。
Common trap：Assuming a horizontal curve means water molecules have completely stopped entering and leaving the cell.

9 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. P
A. P
📌 詳細解釋
DCPIP溶液用來測試維生素C的存在，其濃度與令1cm³ DCPIP脫色所需的果汁量成反比。
DCPIP is used to detect vitamin C, and the concentration is inversely proportional to the amount of juice required to decolourize 1 cm³ of DCPIP.
P果汁所需滴數最少，因此其維生素C濃度最高。
Juice P requires the least amount of juice, so it has the highest vitamin C concentration.
📌 考試提醒
滴定實驗中，達到終點所需的試劑體積與目標物質的實際濃度成反比。
In titration experiments, the volume of reagent required to reach the end-point is inversely proportional to the actual concentration.
常見錯誤：誤以為滴數越多代表果汁內的維生素C濃度越高。
Common trap：Misassuming that a higher number of drops represents a higher concentration of vitamin C.

10 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 吸收最大量的光。
B. To absorb the maximum amount of sunlight.
📌 詳細解釋
植物的葉片以沒有重疊的形式排列，這特徵被稱為葉鑲嵌。
The leaves of the plant are arranged in a way that there is no overlapping.
這確保每一葉片能吸收最多日光以進行光合作用。
This ensures that every leaf can absorb maximum sunlight for photosynthesis.
📌 考試提醒
葉片不重疊排列是為了最大化截取光能的表面積。
The non-overlapping arrangement of leaves maximizes the surface area for light interception.
常見錯誤：誤將葉片排列的適應性目的解釋為減少水分流失。
Common trap：Misinterpreting the adaptive purpose of leaf arrangement as reducing water loss.

11 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. 3和6
D. 3 and 6
📌 詳細解釋
絛蟲的體節（3）扁平且長，增加吸收食物的表面積。
The body (3) of the tapeworm is flat and long to increase the surface area for the absorption of food.
麵包黴的菌絲（6）則延伸進入基質中負責吸收養料。
The hyphae (6) of the bread mould penetrate the substrate to absorb food.
📌 考試提醒
腸道寄生蟲依賴極大的體表總表面積直接吸收周遭的營養物。
Intestinal parasites rely on a massive total body surface area to directly absorb surrounding nutrients.
常見錯誤：混淆麵包黴的根狀菌絲與孢子囊柄的功能。
Common trap：Confusing the functions of the rhizoidal hyphae and the sporangiophore of bread mould.

12 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 只有1和2
C. Only 1 and 2
📌 詳細解釋
構造1為掛鉤，構造2為吸盤，兩者負責將絛蟲附著於小腸壁上。
Structures 1 (hooks) and 2 (suckers) are responsible for attaching the worm to the wall of the small intestine.
構造3是體節，主要負責吸收養分，並無固著功能。
Structure 3 is the body proglottid, mainly for nutrient absorption, without attachment functions.
📌 考試提醒
寄生生物需具備特定的附著結構以抵抗消化道的蠕動。
Parasitic organisms require specific attachment structures to resist peristalsis in the digestive tract.
常見錯誤：誤將整條絛蟲的體節都當作具備附著能力的器官。
Common trap：Mistakenly assuming that the body proglottids function as organs capable of attachment.

13 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 肝
B. Liver
📌 詳細解釋
為防止在暗淡光線下視力不良，人體需要維生素A以合成視網膜內的視紫紅質。
To prevent poor vision in dim light, vitamin A is required to synthesize visual purple.
在所提供的食物中，肝含有最多維生素A。
Among the foods provided, liver contains the most vitamin A.
📌 考試提醒
維生素A屬於脂溶性維生素，主要儲存於動物的肝臟器官內。
Vitamin A is a fat-soluble vitamin and is primarily stored within the liver organs of animals.
常見錯誤：無法準確配對夜盲症與維生素A缺乏。
Common trap：Failing to accurately pair night blindness with vitamin A deficiency.

14 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 只有(2)和(3)
C. Only (2) and (3)
📌 詳細解釋
構造P是微血管網，負責供應氧氣給細胞並運走從小腸吸收的葡萄糖和氨基酸。
Structure P are blood capillaries which supply oxygen to cells and transport absorbed glucose and amino acids.
脂肪酸和甘油則主要是由構造Q（乳糜管）負責運走。
Fatty acids and glycerol are mainly transported away by structure Q (lacteal).
📌 考試提醒
小腸絨毛的微血管負責吸收水溶性分子，而乳糜管負責吸收脂溶性分子。
The blood capillaries in intestinal villi absorb water-soluble molecules, while lacteals absorb fat-soluble molecules.
常見錯誤：誤以為絨毛內的微血管負責運走所有種類的消化產物。
Common trap：Assuming that the blood capillaries within the villus transport all types of digested products.

15 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. 大動脈
A. Aorta
📌 詳細解釋
構造P接收來自動脈的血液，該動脈是大動脈的分支之一。
Structure P receives blood from the mesenteric artery which is a branch of the aorta.
血液在離開小腸後才會運輸至肝門靜脈，故血液並非來自肝門靜脈。
Blood is transported to the hepatic portal vein only after leaving the small intestine, so it does not come from it.
📌 考試提醒
消化器官的供血動脈皆直接或間接分支自大動脈。
The supplying arteries for digestive organs branch directly or indirectly from the aorta.
常見錯誤：誤將血管匯聚後流出的去向當作血液流入的來源。
Common trap：Mistaking the destination of the outflowing convergent vessels as the source of incoming blood.

16 🔴
📌 參考答案
A. 含有抗體
A. Contains antibodies
📌 詳細解釋
構造Q為乳糜管，內裡的淋巴液含有抗體和白血球。
Structure Q is the lacteal, and the lymph fluid inside contains antibodies and white blood cells.
在禁食時，淋巴液不帶脂肪，故不會呈乳白色。
During fasting, lymph carries no fat and thus is not milky.
📌 考試提醒
淋巴系統是免疫防禦機制的一部份，富含對抗病原體的抗體及淋巴細胞。
The lymphatic system is part of the immune defence mechanism, rich in antibodies and lymphocytes.
常見錯誤：誤以為乳糜管內的淋巴液會持續維持乳白色澤。
Common trap：Mistaking that the lymph within the lacteal continuously maintains a milky appearance.

17 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. (1)、(2)和(3)
D. (1), (2) and (3)
📌 詳細解釋
構造1為肋骨，作為堅硬骨架能保護肺部和心臟，並與肋間肌一起協助通氣。
Structure 1 is the ribs, which protect the lungs and heart, and aid in ventilation together with intercostal muscles.
成人肋骨內的骨髓也負責製造紅血球。
The bone marrow within adult ribs is also responsible for forming red blood cells.
📌 考試提醒
胸廓骨骼不僅提供物理保護及參與通氣，也是活躍的造血組織。
The thoracic skeleton not only provides physical protection and ventilation but is also an active haemopoietic tissue.
常見錯誤：完全忽略了骨骼系統本身的造血功能。
Common trap：Completely ignoring the haemopoietic function of the skeletal system itself.

18 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 2和5
B. 2 and 5
📌 詳細解釋
在呼吸時，構造2（肋間肌）與構造5（橫膈膜）會有節奏地收縮和放鬆以進行通氣。
During breathing, structures 2 (intercostal muscles) and 5 (diaphragm) contract and relax rhythmically for ventilation.
肺部和肋膜腔本身並無肌肉組織，無法主動發力收縮。
The lungs and pleural cavity lack muscle tissues and cannot actively contract.
📌 考試提醒
吸氣是依靠骨骼肌主動收縮以增加胸腔體積的過程。
Inspiration is a process relying on active skeletal muscle contraction to increase thoracic volume.
常見錯誤：誤將肺部組織視為可以主動發力收縮的結構。
Common trap：Misidentifying lung tissues as structures capable of active contraction.

19 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 吸煙
B. Smoking
📌 詳細解釋
香煙中的尼古丁會導致心血管疾病，而焦油會損害氣管的纖毛。
Nicotine in cigarettes can cause heart diseases, and tar damages the cilia in the trachea.
飲酒主要損害肝臟，過多脂肪則增加高血壓危險，但均不直接損害氣管。
Alcohol mainly damages the liver, and excess fat increases hypertension risk, but neither directly damages the trachea.
📌 考試提醒
吸煙會同時對呼吸系統（破壞纖毛）及循環系統（引發心血管病）造成損害。
Smoking simultaneously damages the respiratory system (destroying cilia) and the circulatory system (inducing cardiovascular diseases).
常見錯誤：認為所有不良飲食習慣皆會對氣管造成直接破壞。
Common trap：Assuming all poor dietary habits cause direct damage to the trachea.

20 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 15g
C. 15g
📌 詳細解釋
對照組中，氯化鈣從空氣中吸收了5g水份（105g - 100g）。
In the control group, CaCl2 absorbed 5g of water from the air (105g - 100g).
實驗組的總吸收量為20g（120g - 100g），扣除空氣背景水份後，由植物散失的水份為15g。
The total absorption in the experimental group is 20g (120g - 100g); after deducting the background air moisture, the water lost by the plant is 15g.
📌 考試提醒
設計科學實驗時必須設置對照實驗以扣除環境干擾因素。
When designing experiments, a control setup must be used to deduct environmental interference.
常見錯誤：忘記扣除對照組所量度到的本底背景水份。
Common trap：Forgetting to deduct the baseline background water moisture measured by the control group.

21 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 相對濕度降低
C. A decrease in relative humidity
📌 詳細解釋
植物的失水速率可以通過降低四周的相對濕度而增加。
The rate of water loss from the plant can be increased by a decrease in surrounding relative humidity.
增加光強度、氣溫或氣流速率也能增加失水速率，因此A、B和D均會減慢蒸騰作用，為不正確選項。
An increase in light intensity, temperature or rate of air flow also increases water loss, so A, B, and D would slow down transpiration and are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
相對濕度與蒸騰速率成反比，而光強度、溫度及風速與蒸騰速率成正比。
Relative humidity is inversely proportional to the transpiration rate, while light intensity, temperature, and wind speed are directly proportional to it.
常見錯誤：混淆環境因素與蒸騰速率的正反比關係，以為高濕度能加速水分蒸發。
Common trap：Confusing the direct and inverse relationships between environmental factors and transpiration, assuming high humidity accelerates evaporation.

22 🔴
📌 參考答案
C. 膽汁色素
C. Bile pigments
📌 詳細解釋
舊血球在肝臟或脾臟分解，形成含有膽色素的膽汁，而膽汁分泌入小腸幫助消化，因此血液不會含有膽色素。
Aged blood cells are decomposed in the liver or spleen to form bile which contains bile pigments, and bile is secreted into the small intestine to aid in digestion; therefore, blood does not contain bile pigments.
正常血液中會運送從乳糜管進入的脂肪微滴、血漿蛋白質以及溶解的二氧化碳，因此A、B及D不正確。
Normal blood transports fat droplets emptied from lacteals, plasma proteins, and dissolved carbon dioxide, so A, B, and D are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
膽汁色素是紅血球中血紅蛋白分解的代謝廢物，經由膽管排入消化道而非進入血液循環。
Bile pigments are metabolic wastes from the breakdown of haemoglobin in red blood cells, excreted into the digestive tract via the bile duct rather than entering the blood circulation.
常見錯誤：誤以為血液負責運送膽汁色素到各個器官。
Common trap：Mistakenly assuming that blood is responsible for transporting bile pigments to various organs.

23 🔴
📌 參考答案
D. 血壓較低的血
D. Blood at a lower pressure
📌 詳細解釋
所有靜脈的功能是將血液帶回心臟，因此其血壓必然遠低於動脈。
The function of all veins is to carry blood back to the heart, thus their blood pressure must be much lower than that of arteries.
A和B不正確，因為肺靜脈攜帶含氧及低二氧化碳水平的血液。
A and B are incorrect because the pulmonary vein carries oxygenated blood which is not rich in carbon dioxide.
C不正確，因為肝門靜脈在餐後攜帶含高葡萄糖水平的血液。
C is incorrect since the hepatic portal vein carries blood with a high glucose level after a meal.
📌 考試提醒
靜脈的共通特徵是引導血液回心、血壓低及具有瓣膜防止血液倒流。
The common characteristics of veins are directing blood back to the heart, low blood pressure, and possessing valves to prevent backflow.
常見錯誤：誤以為所有靜脈都一定攜帶缺氧血，忽略了肺靜脈的特例。
Common trap：Mistakenly assuming all veins must carry deoxygenated blood, ignoring the exception of the pulmonary vein.

24 🔴
📌 參考答案
B. 輸送氧 / 幫助凝血 / 吞食細菌
B. Transport oxygen / aid in blood clotting / engulf germs
📌 詳細解釋
構造1為紅血球，主要負責運輸氧氣。
Structure 1 is the red blood cell, which mainly transports oxygen.
構造2為血小板，負責凝血作用以防止失血。
Structure 2 represents platelets, which are responsible for blood clotting to prevent blood loss.
構造3為吞噬細胞（白血球的一種），負責通過吞噬細菌進行身體防禦。
Structure 3 is the phagocyte (a type of white blood cell), responsible for body defence by engulfing germs.
📌 考試提醒

Only about 10% of energy in an ecosystem is transferred to the next trophic level; the rest is mainly lost as heat through respiration or remains in egested wastes and dead bodies.
常見錯誤：誤以為植物進行任何生理過程（如蒸騰作用）都會無可避免地消耗其生物量中所儲存的能量。
Common trap：Mistakenly assuming that any physiological process in plants (like transpiration) inevitably consumes the energy stored within their biomass.
